title: Digest verification only when signature lists digest
description: inbox.rs:381-398. The build_signed_string function only verifies the Digest header when 'digest' appears in the signature's headers_list. However, verify_and_fetch_actor at lines 544-548 already enforces that 'digest' must be in the headers_list. The real issue is the logic at lines 389-398: when the Digest header IS present, the code recomputes the digest and compares — but then uses the *computed* digest (not the header value) in the signed string. This is correct for verification but means that if a Digest header is absent (which can't happen due to line 544-548 enforcement), the computed value would still be used. This is fine in current code but the comment on line 382-383 is misleading — it says 'recompute and use that; if a Digest header is present, we verify it matches' implying the header might be absent.
close_reason: Not a bug — the enforcement at lines 544-548 makes this path unreachable. The misleading comment is cosmetic, not a code review finding.
